product_name: COOHGRUBS Dried Mealworms for Birds, Non-GMO High Protein Chicken Treats & Poultry Feed, 2 lb Bag
short_description:
There’s a reason your chickens come running the second they hear the rustle of the bag — COOHGRUBS Dried Mealworms are the ultimate chicken treats they truly go wild for. Packed with 52% clean, natural protein and essential amino acids, these dried mealworms for chickens support stronger feathers, better egg production, and faster recovery during molt. But it’s not just your flock that benefits — our worms are also a favorite among wild birds, making them perfect as mealworms for wild birds. Whether you’re sprinkling them into daily chicken feed or hand-feeding as a reward, these non-GMO, additive-free grubs are irresistible to your whole backyard.
From hatchlings to layers, dried mealworms are a year-round powerhouse every bird owner should have on hand. Toss a handful in the coop to spark excitement, mix them into regular chicken feed for a protein boost, or scatter them on a platform feeder to attract bluebirds, robins, and other songbirds. These mealworms aren’t just snacks — they’re tools for enrichment, health, and connection. Watch your hens strut with glossy feathers, your eggs develop deeper yolks, and your yard come alive with winged visitors drawn to the same irresistible grubs. Whether you call them worms, mealworms, or grubs — COOHGRUBS delivers the taste, nutrition, and joy your feathered friends deserve.
